📜 Game Controls & Guide

🎮 Movement & Camera

  • W, A, S, D : Move forward, backward, strafe
  • Shift : Sprint (consumes stamina)
  • Space : Jump
  • V : Toggle camera view (3rd person / 1st person)
  • Shift / Ctrl + Wheel or PageUp / PageDown : Camera distance (Zoom in/out)
  • Mouse : Look around

⚔️ Actions & Tools

  • 1 – 8 : Hotbar. Press [X] / [0] or click weapon for Fists
  • Left Click (Hold) : Harvest trees, rocks, crops
  • Left Click : Attack enemies or cast fishing rod
  • E : Interact (Talk to NPCs, open chests, campfire cooking)

🎒 Menus & Inventory

  • C : Crafting Menu (Weapons, tools, armor, food)
  • B : Building Mode & Structures
  • I / Tab : Backpack & Character Equipment
  • M : World Map & Landmarks
  • O : Skill Tree & Special Abilities
  • Esc : Pause Menu / Settings

🔥 Survival Rules

  • Eat berries, cooked meat, and fish to restore health & stamina.
  • Campfires grant warmth, rested buffs, and cook raw food!
  • Dangerous night beasts roam in the dark — stay near light!

🗺️ Villages & Landmarks of the Realm

🏛️ Central Village (The Valley Settlement)

A sheltered settlement in the heart of the valley. Here you will find the Chieftain's Great Hall, the Blacksmith's Forge, bustling market stalls, Elder Einar, and blacksmith Ilmari.

⚓ Satamakylä (Fishermen's Haven)

A riverside fishing settlement with long wooden piers and smokehouses. Fish for trout, northern pike, and golden salmon here. Fisherman Toivo guides you at the pier.

🏰 Highland Fortress (Forest Guard)

A stone watchtower and garrison hall standing atop the northern ridge. The fortress parapet commands an unobstructed view across the entire valley.

🔮 Ancient Sanctuary

Moss-covered runic vaults resting in the eastern hills, centered around a mysteriously pulsing turquoise crystal.
